Engine.Name: Rendering engine
Engine.Hint: Ember engine: the module's own engine, with gravity. Foundry: the particle generator built into Foundry v14 (experimental). Applies to every player.

Performance.Name: Particle quality
Performance.Hint: Reduces how many particles are drawn on this computer. Useful for modest machines.

Error.GMOnly: Only the GM can edit emitters.
Error.NoParticleApi: Ember: Foundry's particle generator was not found. Ember requires Foundry VTT v14.

Wind.Title: Scene wind
Wind.Hint: Pushes every effect on the scene. Each effect reacts its own way: smoke and leaves blow away, fire barely bends, magic ignores it.

WindBehavior.campfire: flares up: more, taller, brighter flames
WindBehavior.torch: brightens and flickers, goes out in a storm and relights afterwards
WindBehavior.candle: flickers, goes out in a draft and relights when it dies down

Light.Title: Light
Light.AutoNone: Ember light (this effect gives no light)
Light.LinkHint: Sorted from nearest to farthest from the emitter, with bright/dim radii. It goes out, flickers and flares with the flame; its document is never changed.
Light.VisionHint: Checked: a real Foundry light that counts for vision (a blown-out flame plunges the area into darkness). Unchecked: a visual glow only, with no effect on what tokens see.
Light.Follows: The light follows the flame: off when blown out, stronger when the wind stokes it, dipping when it flickers.
Light.EmberOnly: Adaptive light only works with the Ember engine (module settings).
